hsrNote: Wikidata 沒有標成「高速鐵路線」、或沒有啟用日期的高鐵不算，所以奧地利、瑞士、丹麥、波蘭、俄羅斯（Sapsan 跑在改良的舊線上）、美國（Acela）等國家沒有值；中國最早的是 2003 年的秦瀋客運專線（一般常說的京津城際是 2008 年）。
hsrNoteEn: High-speed lines not classed as such in Wikidata, or without an opening date, are not counted, so Austria, Switzerland, Denmark, Poland, Russia (Sapsan runs on an upgraded line) and the United States (Acela) have no value; China’s earliest is the Qinhuangdao–Shenyang line of 2003 (the Beijing–Tianjin intercity line of 2008 is often cited instead).
